summary: Reproduced and fixed the HTTP 500 affecting the seeded express-order lookup across a month boundary.
root_cause: Express delivery was calculated with datetime.replace(day=placed_at.day + 2). The seeded express order is dated on the previous month's final day, so this attempted to construct an invalid calendar date and raised ValueError: day is out of range for month.
evidence: The alert targets GET /api/orders/express-1002 and explicitly allows a fix.
express-1002 is seeded with created_at set to the previous month's final day.
The focused regression test reproduced ValueError at app/main.py in order_detail().
The defect originated in the starter code and was not introduced by the recent observability changes.
The evidence packet is a firing production-style alert, not an explicit test notification.
verification: Replaced calendar-field mutation with placed_at + timedelta(days=2).
Added test_express_order_lookup_across_month_boundary covering the reported endpoint and expected date.
Before fix, the focused regression failed with ValueError: day is out of range for month.
After fix, uv run --frozen pytest -q completed with 4 passed and 2 deprecation warnings.
git diff --check reported no whitespace errors.
final_line: The express-order lookup failed because invalid month-end date replacement was used instead of two-day timedelta arithmetic.
